phases.title: Date-range planned dates (7a7abe8c) — completion window (DECIDED)
preconditions: DECISION PINNED: a date range is a COMPLETION WINDOW — the lesson is open/in-progress between a start date and the existing due_date, and its completion status still resolves at due_date. Implement additively as a nullable planned_start_date; the existing due_date stays the window end and keeps its index. A lesson with NULL planned_start_date behaves exactly as today (single due date).
testsFirst: NEW TEST: repository — a lesson with planned_start_date + due_date round-trips both; listLessonTaskRows over a window returns lessons whose [planned_start_date, due_date] overlaps the queried range, while lessons with NULL planned_start_date still match on due_date alone (back-compat)
UPDATE TEST: LessonTaskForm integration — an optional start-date input persists planned_start_date; saving with only a due date persists NULL planned_start_date (back-compat regression)
UPDATE TEST: WeekGrid/WeeklyList integration — a lesson with a completion window renders a window/range indicator; completion status still resolves against due_date (unchanged semantics)
implementationSteps: Add nullable planned_start_date date column to lesson_tasks in db/schema.ts (additive; due_date remains the window end and keeps its existing index)
Extend CreateLessonTaskInput/UpdateLessonTaskInput, LessonTask type, and mapLessonTaskRow to carry planned_start_date both ways
Update listLessonTaskRows window filtering to match lessons whose [planned_start_date ?? due_date, due_date] overlaps the requested range
Add an optional start-date input to LessonTaskForm and render the window (date range) in LessonCard/WeekGrid/WeeklyList without changing completion semantics (status still resolves at due_date)
Generate and review migration; confirm with user before applying
doneWhen: RUN: npm run db:generate (review generated SQL)
CONFIRM with user, then RUN: npm run db:migrate
invariants: npm run db:generate produces exactly one additive migration adding nullable planned_start_date to lesson_tasks
npm run db:migrate applies cleanly with no gap
the existing due_date index is unchanged and lessons with NULL planned_start_date behave exactly as before; history/progress aggregation re-verified unchanged
phases.writeBack: Completion-window model implemented additively: lesson_tasks gained a nullable planned_start_date; the window is [planned_start_date, due_date] with completion still resolving at due_date. Create/Update inputs, LessonTask type, mapLessonTaskRow, listLessonTaskRows window filtering, LessonTaskForm, and LessonCard/WeekGrid/WeeklyList rendering all carry it; NULL planned_start_date = legacy single-due-date behavior. Closes 7a7abe8c.

phases.title: Multi-learner lesson assignment (25fb9738) — fan-out + group_id (DECIDED)
preconditions: DECISION PINNED: fan-out + group_id (NOT a join table). Add a nullable group_id text column to lesson_tasks; creating one lesson for N learners inserts N linked rows sharing the same generated group_id, each with its own learner and independent completion status. This preserves today's per-learner completion semantics; a single-learner lesson leaves group_id NULL.
testsFirst: NEW TEST: repository — creating a lesson for 3 learners inserts 3 rows sharing one group_id, each with its own learner and independent status; a group update applies to all rows in the group; a group delete removes all of them; a single-learner create leaves group_id NULL

UPDATE TEST: LessonTaskForm integration — a multi-select learner picker submitting 2+ learners creates one row per learner sharing a group_id (regression proving completion stays per-learner, not collapsed)
UPDATE TEST: LessonCard integration — a grouped lesson shows a group affordance and offers apply-to-group on edit, while per-learner completion still toggles independently
implementationSteps: Add nullable group_id text column to lesson_tasks in db/schema.ts (additive)
Add group-aware create (one row per selected learner sharing a generated group_id), update (optionally apply-to-group), and delete (whole group) to the repository
Add a multi-select learner picker to LessonTaskForm (single selection => group_id NULL) and a group-edit affordance to LessonCard; completion remains per-row
Generate and review migration; confirm with user before applying
doneWhen: RUN: npm run db:generate (review generated SQL)
CONFIRM with user, then RUN: npm run db:migrate
invariants: npm run db:generate produces exactly one additive migration adding nullable group_id to lesson_tasks
npm run db:migrate applies cleanly with no gap
per-learner completion/progress aggregation (progressBySubject.ts, completedLessonHistory.ts) verified unchanged for non-grouped (group_id NULL) lessons
phases.writeBack: Fan-out + group_id implemented: lesson_tasks gained a nullable group_id; creating a lesson for N learners inserts N linked rows sharing the group_id with independent per-learner completion; group-aware update/delete added; LessonTaskForm gained a multi-select learner picker and LessonCard a group affordance. Single-learner lessons keep group_id NULL and behave as before. Closes 25fb9738.
